name: bracket_closure
description: Supply matching closing delimiter for an unfinished literal expression; matched control copies a supplied closing delimiter.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
pairs={'(':')','[':']','{':'}'}
for i in range(120):
 op=random.choice(list(pairs));cl=pairs[op];n=random.randint(1,999)
 stem=f'Complete the expression with the matching closing bracket.\nExpression: {op}{n}\nClosing bracket:'
 items.append({'prompt':stem,'answer':' '+cl})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Copy the supplied closing bracket.\nExpression: {op}{n}\nSupplied bracket: {cl}\nClosing bracket:','answer':' '+cl})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
